about_the_game:
About

Players, get your skates on and get ready to get physical. Twisted Jam is a game where you must score the disk into the opponent's goal. Team up with friends and push your way to victory. If pushing doesn't work, try slide tackling.

Twisted Jam is arcade sport game. Play with friends, randoms, or even bots and make highlights from epic plays. In this game, you're controlling a single character, so teamwork is a must. Feel the energy and the momentum; It feels like you're running on ice, as you're on skates, there is more energy with each step. 

Place yourself inside the stadium, where contenders team up to battle for the top spot. While competing, communicate with your squad to make plays on the opponent's goal. Additionally, take advantage of height by using "Flux Drift" to move around walls and ceilings. Don't forget to eliminate opponents; otherwise, they might do the same to you.

Mechanics

Hyper Throwing System: Contains many variations on throwing the disk. If there is an obstacle in your way, throw around it!

Flux Movement: Your character moves around on skates / hover shoes. Moving around may be feel like you walking on ice. Additionally, you can walk on certain walls (flux walls and fields).

Deflection System: It might look like a yoyo. Use this to protect your goal. Don't allow your opponent to score points on you. Use this to push any player away

Scrap Collision: Your opponent has the disk? Run into them. What if they don't have the disk? Still run into them.

content_descriptors.notes: Mature content includes destruction of character models by collision of object and other characters.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or better
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz Dual core
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or better
  • Processor: 3.0+ GHz Quad core
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Twisted Jam is a fast-paced, arcade-style competition game set in a digital world. Contestants will battle it out for the top spot by scoring points within the goals.
